title: Reverse Linked List
microsoftNote: Iterative three-pointer reverse. Also have the recursive version ready.
statement:
Given the head of a singly linked list, reverse the list and return the new head.

The judge passes arrays; they are converted to `ListNode` for you.
constraints: The number of nodes is in [0, 5000].
followUp: Reverse it both iteratively and recursively.
editorial: prev = None. While head: nxt = head.next; head.next = prev; prev = head; head = nxt. Return prev.
